item_name: Rothco Canvas Small Black Police Logo Gear Bag
item_short_desc: Rothco’s  Canvas Small Black Police Logo Gear Bag is a perfect addition for your police and law enforcement gear collection.
description: Rothco’s canvas police bag is a perfect addition for your police and law enforcement gear collection. Made with a heavyweight canvas material, this canvas bag features a ‘Police’ logo on both sides. Polyester zipper closure to main and outside snap pockets offer optimal storage for small gear and accessories. Measuring 11" X 7" X 6", the tactical police bag has two sturdy carry handles to help withstand the weight of your tactical equipment.
